name: Misi's Playground
desc:
Inspired by People Playground

Misi's Playground is a Sandbox game that takes place in a giant underground facility where you can
experiment on various ragdolls,
build whatever comes to your mind,
explore lots of different maps,
play around with a huge selection of tools,
and more..

Make sure to rate the game and leave feedback, it helps a lot :)


🩸Tags: People Playground, Garry's Mod, sandbox, building tools, simulation, building, PvP, physics, blood, gore, ragdoll, horror
